entries.value: "User teams store (SQLite store at ~/.base-studio-code/orgs.db) for base-studio-code (#2193, #2700) — the persona-relationship graph: positions connected by relationship archetypes that expand into communication forms. A thin teams-specific shim over the shared bsc-json-store (#2158), reachable from the Tauri app's teams bridge and the session-facing `bsc teams` CLI (with the deprecated `bsc org` alias). The on-disk store dir stays `orgs/` so existing saved data is not orphaned."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_teams` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold (#2158) — this crate supplies only the
# org-specific nouns + lean `list` fields via a CliSpec.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog, and `resolve_store_path`
# so `model` reaches the same store every other verb does (`--dir` > env > default).
# The ONE home-dir resolver (#1646) — AND the canonical model-tier registry `model` validates
# against, so a tier this CLI accepts is one the harness can launch.
# `model` validates a non-tier name against what the LOCAL RUNTIME has installed — THE ONE RULE
# lives in `llm::cli::verify_model`, beside the blocking probe it needs, rather than being restated
# here. The placement is the per-NODE level of the precedence chain and was the only level not
# `model` patches ONE position of the stored team without re-serializing a typed model.
